hypotheses.H1: environmental stress produces stage-localized rather than uniform weakening of life-cycle coupling
hypotheses.H2: hydroperiod and aquatic-habitat conditions explain which downstream transition becomes limiting
hypotheses.H3: bottleneck location differs among species with different reproductive and larval-development strategies
hypotheses.H4: a broad amphibian claim requires recurrence in at least one independent monitoring programme

primary_selection_rule: audit each candidate without fitting transition-response models
reject candidates lacking repeat-visit or explicit stage information needed for the intended endpoint
for cross-programme analysis require publisher-provided compatible site/event identity or a frozen deterministic identity bridge established without outcome values
select the richest endpoint supported by at least 30 site-years and adequate repeat visits; this is a structural screen, not a power or significance threshold
if juvenile timing/detection is not identifiable, downgrade the endpoint prospectively to adult-to-egg/larva rather than infer recruitment
record all candidate exclusions and do not return to a rejected candidate because another candidate gives an unfavourable ecological result
